sara: heads up — Callisto29b quant canary hitting OOMs with prefix-heavy requests after ~8 new tokens. repro on int4 canary nodes only. logs attached inline. :frowning_face:

miguel: repro steps? 

sara: simple seq2seq style prompt with long prefix (400 tokens) + short generation (max_new_tokens=32). happens with batching > 2. stacktrace shows mem spike in kv_cache_alloc.

akshay: can you paste the minimal log snippet?

sara: ```
ERR OOM: kv_cache_alloc failed at 0x7ff... size=1.2G
alloc order:
  prefetch: enabled
  kv_slots: 8192
  quant: int4-delta
  kernel: fused-attn-v2
```

lucy: int4-delta? that's our new per-channel delta quant path — we switched kernels last night for latency. might be spilling extra metadata per slot.

noah: i've seen int4-delta keep a tiny shadow buffer per KV entry for dequant. if prefix is long, num slots x shadow_size blows memory.

miguel: two hypotheses: (1) shadow buffer per-slot leaks because eviction not trimming metadata, (2) eviction policy picks wrong victim with adaptive windowing leading to heavy fragmentation and failed big alloc.

akshay: quick checks: bump max_new_tokens down to 16 and set prefetch=0 to see if it prevents OOMs (non-prod). also try slot_compaction=on.

lucy: adding to that — disable delta-quant kernel on canary and fallback to int4-basic to confirm kernel correlation.

noah: running local smoke now: command i used: `env MODEL=callisto29b KERNEL=int4-delta PREFETCH=1 BATCH=4 ./run_canary.sh`

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/callisto29b-int4-delta -> nodegroup-canary-7 (id: cg-77)

sara: test results: with PREFETCH=0 + max_new_tokens=16, no OOMs across 200 requests. with PREFETCH=1 + default max_new_tokens=32, OOMs consistent.

miguel: good signal. next step: reproduce with int4-basic kernel on same config to isolate. akshay, can you flip kernel and run same batch sweep?

akshay: flipping now. switching KERNEL=int4-basic and keeping PREFETCH=1 BATCH=4 max_new_tokens=32.

akshay: result: no OOMs after 500 runs. latency slightly higher (~6%) but stable.

lucy: sounds like int4-delta is allocating extra per-slot metadata and eviction path isn't trimming it when KV entries are evicted. that would cause fragmentation and then big contiguous alloc fails.

noah: quick mitigation options:
- revert canary to int4-basic (safest)
- reduce default max_new_tokens for callisto to 16 for int4-delta users
- add immediate slot_compact on eviction to free shadow buffers
- disable prefetch for int4-delta until fixed

miguel: prioritize revert + ticket. revert will buy time to debug.

sara: filing ticket with logs and repro + perf delta notes. tagging infra for canary revert.

sara: ticket: CLST-4982 — callisto int4-delta: prefix shadow buffer leak via eviction path. includes heap profiles, alloc traces, and canary run IDs.

akshay: i'll take the bug. plan: reproduce in dev with ASAN-like allocator, add logging in eviction path to ensure metadata freed, then unit test. estimate 2 days.

lucy: i'll prepare a config change to set callisto max_new_tokens default to 16 for int4-delta users and add a rollout gate. small PR ready if you want to ship quick.

noah: for observability, we should add a mem-per-slot metric (shadow_bytes_per_kv) and a kv_eviction_trim_count to console dashboards. will help detect regression earlier.

miguel: agreed. add alerts if mem_per_slot * active_slots > 50% of GPU free mem.

deploy-bot: canary revert queued: revert/callisto-int4-delta -> nodegroup-canary-7 (id: cg-77)

sara: thanks. action items summarized:
- akshay: CLST-4982 bugfix + unit tests (2d)
- lucy: PR to default max_new_tokens=16 for int4-delta + rollout gate (ship today)
- noah: dashboard + alert work (1d)
- miguel: coordinate canary revert (now)

miguel: follow-ups: after fix, run a benchmark comparing int4-basic vs int4-delta at prefixes 100/200/400 tokens to quantify cost/latency/quality tradeoffs. include tokenization edgecases.

sara: adding quality note — we saw slight perplexity improvement with delta kernel on some eval prompts, so prefer to fix rather than abandon.

akshay: taking ownership. will post updates in this thread and link the PR/patch.

lucy: :thumbsup:

noah: ping me if you need extra profiler runs.

sara: closing loop — canary revert completed, traffic stable. will reopen when fix lands. thanks team :rocket:
